lines.en: My shadow covers half the field
My plates are thicker, my motion heavier
I push the air ahead of me
One of my strides spans three of yours
I skim the treetops low
My bulk turns slowly
Ki roars beneath my feet
I snap the branches in my way
I move with a long shadow behind me
The wind grows loud as I close
I rise half a block and settle
My heavy shell edge cuts the air
This is my true shape
I spread my shoulders slowly
The light on my fingertip is thicker
I look down on everything below
My breath shakes the air
I have no need to shrink back
Violet light leaks between my plates
My fist creaks as it closes
I stay still, and my presence presses
I let out a slow breath

lines.zh: 我歪头看你渺小的样子
lines.en: I tilt my head at how small you are

lines.zh: 我的尾巴轻轻扫过地面
lines.en: My tail brushes along the ground
I put my hands behind my back
I am savoring this moment
You think you deserve this form
I lean in to see you better
You can barely stand now
My eyes glow beneath the plates
Your ki is a thread to me
One hand would cover you
Do you have any last words
I wait for you to steady your weapon
You are backing away
Is this all the courage you have
I narrow my eyes and study you
I laugh, slow and low
Your voice is shaking
I lower my head level with yours
Do you see my shadow
One finger is all I need
You are blocking my light
I take one last look at you
I stagger once
A dent stays in my shell
I lower myself and pause
That made the air itself shake
I wipe the blood from my lip
I reset my stance
My ki thins for a moment
That cannot be happening
My gaze turns serious on you
I am not at my limit
This form needs no feeding
You try to coax me with food
I could swallow a whole forest
Keep it for yourself
I think nothing of such things
What you bring is far too small
My hunger is not like yours
Away with it, I am working
I do not eat, I want results
That is no offering
You hit my leg and rebound
I stand unmoved as a mountain
The impact lands with a thud
Not a mark on my shell
You cannot shift me an inch
Move, you are in my way
My knee blocks you
The clang rolls down the valley
You are the one who fell
Is that what you call impact
This form needs no companion
I acknowledge only the strong

lines.zh: 我没打算在这里留下后代
lines.en: I plan no heirs here
I carry my line alone
This talk wastes my time
You are asking the wrong question
I am enough by myself
I stop for no one
Solitude is not weakness
I want this over quickly
It breaks the moment I grip

lines.zh: 这么大的手抓不住小东西
lines.en: These hands are too big for trifles
I lift it up to look
I toss it back down
It is dust in my palm
I crumble it without thinking
I keep it as a trophy
So light it has no weight
I tuck it into a plate seam
I do not even bother to bend
You are inside my circle
This form does not test
I gather all my ki at once

lines.zh: 你的位置我一眼就看穿
lines.en: I see through your position
I raise my whole arm
This strike will reshape the ground
Decided, it is you
You will not get a second lap
You are my only target
The cleanup starts now
I classify you as an obstacle
You have no line of retreat
I fix on your heartbeat
I will level this ground
I lock my ki onto you
Go on, try to move

lines.zh: 你跑到哪都是同一片天
lines.en: Wherever you run, it is the same sky
I lift my hand and the light follows

lines.zh: 你的闪避我看得太清楚
lines.en: Your dodges are perfectly clear
I am deliberately slow

lines.zh: 你躲过两次，不会有第三次
lines.en: Two dodges, there will be no third
I have sealed your route

lines.zh: 残影只是让你多看一眼
lines.en: The afterimage is just for show
I push the clouds apart
Look up and you will see me

lines.zh: 我调整的是角度不是速度
lines.en: I adjust the angle, not the speed
Stop, and I am there
My ki closes in around you
Stop counting my heartbeats
I have waited long for this strike
The ki around you is thinning
Back up more and you will fall
I rise half a block
You cannot hear my steps
My huge palm comes down
A beam cuts across the clearing
A nova presses down from above
I sweep the entire ground
The ki blasts link into a chain
My fist drags a gale with it
My tail snaps a tree trunk
I grab you and slam you down
This kick could crush stone
I hammer you in the air
I add one more strike
The shockwave digs a crater

lines.zh: 我打在你举起的武器上
lines.en: I strike your raised weapon
Your guard snaps in two
I bear down from above
This blow leaves no room
My frame fills the sky
My plates unfold in the light
I descend out of the clouds
The ground shakes first
My ki bursts the air apart
I halt high above you
Violet light floods the field
I raise my hand overhead
The wind circles me
I leave a crater where I stop
I settle into the center of your view
This moment should be remembered
I declare my name
The trees lean toward me
The sky darkens by one shade
I am here, and I hold nothing back
I will close this fight
My shadow lands before I do
The fire turns my whole plate red
I land and blast out a crater

lines.zh: 水压挤着我的甲，气断了
lines.en: The water crushes my shell and my ki cuts

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的甲炸开一道口
lines.en: The blast opens a gap in my shell

lines.zh: 一根小箭弹在我的甲上
lines.en: A small arrow pings off my plate
Magic finds its way through my seams
Ki drained, my body grows heavy
Lightning rings through every plate

lines.zh: 这么大的身躯也止不住下坠
lines.en: Even this bulk cannot stop the fall
